title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. Draw the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face, which consists of two loops. The first loop comprises eight curves: start with an arc from (0.0, 0.0023) to (0.0023, 0.0) via (0.0007, 0.0007), followed by a line from (0.0023, 0.0) to (0.0165, 0.0). Continue with another arc from (0.0165, 0.0) to (0.0188, 0.0023) via (0.0181, 0.0007), and then a line from (0.0188, 0.0023) to (0.0188, 0.0128). Add an arc from (0.0188, 0.0128) to (0.0165, 0.015) via (0.0181, 0.0143), followed by a line from (0.0165, 0.015) to (0.0023, 0.015). Complete the loop with an arc from (0.0023, 0.015) to (0.0, 0.0128) via (0.0007, 0.0143), and a final line from (0.0, 0.0128) to (0.0, 0.0023). The second loop also has eight curves: begin with an arc from (0.0011, 0.0023) to (0.0023, 0.0011) via (0.0015, 0.0015), followed by a line from (0.0023, 0.0011) to (0.0165, 0.0011). Add another arc from (0.0165, 0.0011) to (0.0176, 0.0023) via (0.0173, 0.0015), and then a line from (0.0176, 0.0023) to (0.0176, 0.0128). Continue with an arc from (0.0176, 0.0128) to (0.0165, 0.0139) via (0.0173, 0.0135), followed by a line from (0.0165, 0.0139) to (0.0023, 0.0139). Complete the loop with an arc from (0.0023, 0.0139) to (0.0011, 0.0128) via (0.0015, 0.0135), and a final line from (0.0011, 0.0128) to (0.0011, 0.0023). Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.0188. Rotate the scaled sketch using the Euler angles set to zero degrees and translate it using the translation vector set to zero. Extrude the sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction without extruding in the opposite direction. Create a new solid body from the extruded sketch. The final dimensions of the part are 0.01875 meters in length, 0.015 meters in width, and 0.75 meters in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0023) \
     .threePointArc((0.0007, 0.0007), (0.0023, 0.0)) \
     .lineTo(0.0165, 0.0) \
     .threePointArc((0.0181, 0.0007), (0.0188, 0.0023)) \
     .lineTo(0.0188, 0.0128) \
     .threePointArc((0.0181, 0.0143), (0.0165, 0.015)) \
     .lineTo(0.0023, 0.015) \
     .threePointArc((0.0007, 0.0143), (0.0, 0.0128)) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0023) \
     .close()

# Define the inner sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0011, 0.0023) \
     .threePointArc((0.0015, 0.0015), (0.0023, 0.0011)) \
     .lineTo(0.0165, 0.0011) \
     .threePointArc((0.0173, 0.0015), (0.0176, 0.0023)) \
     .lineTo(0.0176, 0.0128) \
     .threePointArc((0.0173, 0.0135), (0.0165, 0.0139)) \
     .lineTo(0.0023, 0.0139) \
     .threePointArc((0.0015, 0.0135), (0.0011, 0.0128)) \
     .lineTo(0.0011, 0.0023) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
